question: What temporal boundary marks the endpoint of the prescribed maṇḍala period?
premises: The preceding context specifies a duration measured in maṇḍala days.
The compound maṇḍaladināvadhi denotes a limit defined by those days.
inference: The prescribed observance extends up to the limit of the maṇḍala days.
plain_english: Up to the limit of the maṇḍala days.
